meta.name: pm-skill-creator
meta.description: Design a new PM skill through guided conversation. Use when you have raw content or an idea and want to shape it into a compliant skill.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过对话将想法转化为合规技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你有原始内容或想法，想把它塑造成一个合规的技能。
copy.tagline_en: Turn raw ideas into compliant skills through guided conversation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have raw content or an idea and want to shape it into a compliant skill.

howto.what: 它会通过对话引导，把想法或笔记整理成一份符合规范的SKILL.md草稿。会问最多5个问题，判断技能类型，生成完整草稿。
howto.when: 当你有原始内容或想法，想把它变成技能时触发。比如你有一份笔记、一个框架或一个初步想法，但不知道怎么组织。

say.text: 帮我把这个定价框架设计成一个技能
say.note: 它会开启引导对话，先问你的原始素材。

say.text: 我有工作坊笔记，想整理成技能
say.note: 它会让你提供或描述内容，然后提出结构。

say.text: 我想创建一个新技能，但不知道从哪开始
say.note: 它会让你选择引导、内容转储或猜测模式。

howto.what_en: Asks up to 5 questions to shape an idea or raw content into a compliant SKILL.md draft, determining type and structure, then generating a full draft.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you have raw content or an idea and want to shape it into a skill, like notes, a framework, or a rough topic. With no input it asks what the skill should help someone do.

say_en.text: Turn this pricing framework into a skill
I have workshop notes, help me make a skill
say_en.note: Asks you to paste or describe the content.

say_en.text: Create a new skill, I have no structure
say_en.note: Offers Guided, Context dump, or Best guess.
